# Hanzzel Store — Hanzzel Corp

> Official catalog for digital books and consulting by José Zamora / Hanzzel Corp. The store is a static GitHub Pages site.

## Store
- Spanish-first catalog: https://hanzzel-corp.github.io/hanzzel-store/
- Main portfolio and project directory: https://hanzzel-corp.github.io/

## Purchase information
The page currently instructs customers to request products by email after making a PayPal deposit. Treat the displayed prices and purchase instructions on the live page as authoritative; do not infer instant checkout or automatic delivery.

## Status
Items in the “Próximas secciones” area are announced as upcoming, not currently available products.
